newsitem.title: USA: ASI Solutions expects lower Q2 revenues.
newsitem.headline: ASI Solutions expects lower Q2 revenues.

text.p: ASI Solutions Inc said Tuesday it expected lower revenues in the second quarter, partly because of the deferral of demand from merging clients.

"As we look to our second quarter, the effects of accelerated investment will continue to impact earnings," said chief executive Bernard Reynolds. "We also foresee lower revenue levels when compared to the vigorous revenue performance of the quarter just ended.

"Some of this anticipated revenue decline, which we consider to be temporary, can be attributed to a deferral of demand for our services on the part of two major clients in anticipation of their merger."
Revenue during the first fiscal quarter rose to $6,700,275 from $3,911,416 in the comparable period of fiscal 1997. Net
income was $418,070, or $0.07 per share on 6,106,191 shares outstanding, compared with $412,172, or $0.09 per share on 4,667,404 shares outstanding a year ago.
